title: Basket
subtitle: Risk-based weights and vol targeting on the S&P 500 top-50
headline: Tuesday 03 November 2026. Risk parity (ERC) basket: 9.8% ex-ante vol, 48 effective bets, Mag 7 13% of weight for 17% of risk. Realized 22d vol 7.8% (low), VIX 20.8: the 10% vol target sets leverage at 1.28x. Top idea: risk parity (ERC) with the 10% vol target (1.28x today).

sections.title: Today's basket
paragraphs: Risk parity (ERC) on the 50 largest S&P 500 names, Ledoit-Wolf covariance on 252 days (shrinkage intensity 0.062, average pairwise correlation 0.09), 10% cap per name and 30% cap on the Mag 7. Ex-ante vol 9.8%, 48.0 effective bets, diversification ratio 3.11.
The Mag 7 take 13% of the weight and 17% of the risk; cap-weighting would hold them at 54%. Largest position KO at 6.2%. Largest sector by risk: Technology (33% of risk for 21% of weight).

The sample covariance of 50 names on 252 days has a condition number of 8,547; shrinking toward the constant-correlation target brings it to 394. That is why min variance holds 32 names instead of five.

sections.title: Leverage and regime
paragraphs: The Risk parity (ERC) basket realized 7.8% over the last 22 sessions, the 24th percentile since 2015 (low); VIX at 20.8. A 10% vol target sets tomorrow's leverage at 1.28x (cap 2.0x, average 1.02x over the backtest): add exposure, the regime is quiet.

Over 11 years the overlay added +0.19 of Sharpe on average across the six schemes and cut the average worst drawdown from -31% to -15%. The spread of Sharpe between the six schemes is 0.15: the vol target moves the result more than the weights.
On 03 Nov the basket returned -0.11% against +0.30% for SPY and -0.33% for RSP, the equal-weight S&P 500 ETF (12% a year over the window against 15% for equal weight on the point-in-time top 50).

method: Ideas are the baskets to hold this month, ranked by historical conditional expectation (next 21 days) divided by the historical worst case in the same regime. Conditioning variable: the quartile of the basket's trailing 22-day realized vol.
caveats: Point-in-time universe: monthly top N by today's float shares times that month's price; share-count changes and names delisted since are not captured. Today's basket (first section) uses today's names.
Conditional returns are averages over overlapping 21-day windows; they describe the regime, not a forecast.
Costs: 5 bps per unit of turnover, including leverage changes. No financing cost on leverage above 1.
